odvs.description: win22cis_setup_max_log_file_size is the setting that specifies the maximum size of the log file in kilobytes. The maximum log file size can be configured between 1 megabyte (1,024 kilobytes) and 4 terabytes (4,194,240 kilobytes) in kilobyte increments.# The recommended state for this setting is: Enabled: 32,768 or greater.
odvs.name: setup_max_log_file_size

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "18.10.26.3.2 | PATCH | Ensure Setup Specify the maximum log file size KB is set to Enabled 32768 or greater"
  when: win22cis_rule_18_10_26_3_2
  tags:
    - level1-domaincontroller
    - level1-memberserver
    - rule_18.10.26.3.2
    - patch
    - eventlog
    - NIST800-53R5_AU-4
  block:
    - name: "18.10.26.3.2 | PATCH | Ensure Setup Specify the maximum log file size KB is set to Enabled 32768 or greater | Set Variable"
      when: win22cis_setup_max_log_file_size >= 32768
      ansible.windows.win_regedit:
        path: HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Eventlog\Setup
        name: MaxSize
        data: "{{ win22cis_setup_max_log_file_size }}"
        type: dword

    - name: "18.10.26.3.2 | AUDIT | Ensure Setup Specify the maximum log file size KB is set to Enabled 32768 or greater | Warning Check For Variable Standards"
      when: win22cis_setup_max_log_file_size < 32768
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "Warning!! You have an invalid file size set for win22cis_setup_max_log_file_size please read"
          - "the notes for the variable and make the necessary change to the variable to be in compliance."

    - name: "18.10.26.3.2 | AUDIT | Ensure Setup Specify the maximum log file size KB is set to Enabled 32768 or greater | Log a warning"
      when: win22cis_setup_max_log_file_size < 32768
      vars:
        warn_control_id: '18.10.26.3.2'
      ansible.builtin.import_tasks:
        file: warning_facts.yml
